decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the high-speed splash constraint and accepted control methods.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the 3000 RPM maximum, adjustable range, and restriction against routine maximum-speed operation.
Possible bowl-depth adjustment is conditional mitigation for clean high-speed operation and does not necessarily change the selected bowl capacity or form.
The conditional option to adjust whisk position does not change the selected whisk head's size, material, style, or powder compatibility.
The source constrains mixing behavior at higher motor speeds, not the subsequent dispensing flow or froth preservation through the spout.
Avoiding overly aggressive high-speed mixing does not alter the existing repeated-use reliability requirement.
Performing cleanly in this message concerns splash control, not removal, flushing, or sanitation of food-contact components.
The source does not change the solenoid mechanism, button actuation, or pre-dispense isolation behavior.
Splash control and smooth high-speed mixing do not change the separate no-drip and leak-containment requirements.
Conditional openness to bowl-depth adjustment does not necessarily revise the enclosure dimensions, side profile, or deep-well accommodation.
The high-speed mixing constraint has no effect on brand text, placard placement, or intended viewer.
Acceptance of the motor speed range does not change the selected 120V input source, battery exclusion, or V1 power architecture.
